tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal bde mchog lū hi pa'i bla brgyud bstod pa smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa bzhugs/na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dpal ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rgyal sras gsang ba'i bdag /mgon des rjes bzung in+d+ra bho dhi la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan sa ra ha/ /zab don 'grel bar lung bstan klu sgrub zhabs/ /thugs sras rje btsun ri khrod dbang phyug la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /lam 'dis go 'phang mchog brnyes lū hi pa/ /zab lam mthar phyin dā ri ka ba'i zhabs/ /sgyu lus mngon gyur rdo rje dril bu par/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rim gnyis rtogs pa mchog ldan ru sbal zhabs/ /phag mos rjes bzung jā lan+dha ra pa/ / brtul zhugs mchog gyur nag po spyod pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /gsang ba'i man dag mdzod 'dzin gu h+ya pa/ /grub pa'i go 'phang mthor gshegs rnam rgyal zhabs/ /til brdung spyod pas mchog brnyes te lo par/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i mthar son nā ro ta/ /bsgoms pa'i nus pa phul byung pham mthing mched/ / mkhas mchog glog skya shes rab brtsegs nyid la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /sgra sgyur chen po blo gros grags pa'i dpal/ /sa chen rig 'dzin kun dga' snying bo'i zhabs/ /rje btsun dam pa bsod nams rtse mo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /gsang don kun gzigs grags pa rgyal mtshan pa/ /rig gnas mthar son sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ /de sras thu bo rigs pa'i seṅge la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /mkhas btsun chen po sangs rgyas 'bum pa dang*/ /skad gnyis smra ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/

/bla ma dam pa dpal ldan seṅge la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bu ston rin chen grub/ /sngags 'chang kun gyi gtso gyur khyung lhas pa/ /chos kyi rgyal bo rje btsun tsong khabar/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i lung rtogs bstan/ /ji bzhin 'dzin mdzad rim par byon pa yi/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /brtan g.yo'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /dri med lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ngor/ /sdom mdzad he ru ka dpal yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /ma dag skye shi bar do rnam pa gsum/ /rnam dag rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngor/ /bsgyur mdzad 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim gnyis lam/ /bgrod pa'i nyams len mtha' ru phyin par shog /go 'phang mchog de tshe 'dir ma thob kyang*/ /'chi ba'i tshe na bla ma lha tshogs kyis/ /ngo mtshar ltas bzang mang bos bsu mdzad de/ /mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gnas su 'khrid par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ / rgyal ba kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang*/ /ngur smrig gar rol gsang chen rgyud sde yi/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grel mdzad thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyal ba gnyis par grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam bzang mthar thug 'khor lo bde mchog gi /zab lam sgrub pa'i brtson pa lhur mdzad pa/ /mchog thun 'dod rgyu'i 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang thugs sgrib bral bde ba chen po nyid/ /ye shes thugs gsung sku dang dam tshig gi /'khor lor sprul mdzad rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /khyab bdag he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zung 'jug go 'phang bde chen lam nyid kyis/ /thob par mtshon phyir rdo rje phag mo dang*/

/mnyam sbyor lhan skyes bde ba'i sbrang rtsi'i ros/ /rtag tu mngon dgas rol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang sngon ri bzhin rnam thar sgo bzhi'i zhal/ /bcu gnyis spyan dang phyag ldan stong phrag 'od/ /dbang phyug dus mtshan bcas pa'i nyi gdan steng*/ /g.yas brkyangs stabs kyis bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byu ru'i mdangs ldan nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od/ /mi phyed mdza' bas yab la 'khyud pa yis/ /zag med bde ba'i dpal ster bcom ldan ma/ /rdo rje phag mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dran pa nyer gzhag rnam bzhi dag pa'i dngos/ /gcer bu skra grol bzhad pa'i zhal ldan zhing*/ /rab mdzes lang tsho dar ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ /bde chen lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pūl+li ra ma la sogs yul rnams dang*/ /'khor lo sngon po'i rtsibs bzhugs rdo rje'i rigs/ /dbang sngon mdangs ldan mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul/ /thugs 'khor yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kā ma ru ba la sogs yul rnams dang*/ /'khor lo dmar po'i rtsibs bzhugs pad+ma'i rigs/ /pad rag mdangs ldan sa la spyod pa'i tshul/ /gsung 'khor yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phre ta pu ri la sogs yul rnams dang*/ /'khor lo dkar po'i rtsibs bzhugs de yi rigs/ /zla ba'i mdangs ldan sa 'og spyod pa'i tshul/ /sku 'khor yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod sogs rnams dang*/ /dkyil 'khor sgo mtshams brgyad bzhugs las kyi rigs/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral mdog can khros pa'i nyams/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ /bde chen lhan skyes ye shes rol pa las/ /legs 'khrungs 'khor lo lnga yi lha tshogs kyi/ /rten dang brten par shar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ /cung zad bstod las byung ba'i rnam dkar dges/ /rang gzhan kun gyis bde chen dpal rnyed nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig

/de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la/ /mchod bstod bsgoms dang bzlas pa'i dge ba dang*/ /dus gsum legs tshogs ji snyed bsags pa kun/ /bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i gdams pa'i don/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /de las skyob pa'i skyabs 'gro las 'bras la/ /nyams len 'jug ldog tshul bzhin byed par shog /'khor ba'i ngang tshul me 'obs ltar mthong nas/ /thar 'dod nges 'byung shugs drag skye ba dang*/ /ma rnams don du byang chub sems bskyed de/ /phyin drug rlabs chen spyod la 'jug par shog /rnam dag dbang bzhis sku bzhi 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /nus pa 'jog cing dri ma kun bkrus nas/ /rim gnyis rdzogs par bsgom la dbang ba dang*/ /dam tshig sdom pa srung bar byed par shog /tha mal snang zhen dri ma 'khrud byed pa'i/ /bskyed pa'i rim la thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gang snang lha yi 'khor lo 'char nus pa'i/ /rim pa dang po rtogs pa mthar phyin shog /sgo gsum sku gsung thugs kyi dag byed lhas/ /byin gyis brlabs pas bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*/ /zhing gi mchog la dmigs nas mchod pa yis/ /rlabs chen bsod nams tshogs ni rdzogs par shog /spros kun 'od gsal bsdus pa'i stong nyid las/ /nā da'i gzugs ldang zla bar zhugs pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs skye 'chi bar do gsum/ /sku gsum lam du 'khyer bar byed nus shog /gang du bsnun pa'i rtsa 'khor sogs mtshon phyir/ /'byung bzhi ri rab pad+ma zla ba sogs/ /bsgoms pas dkar dmar cha yi babs 'dzeg las/ /nges don lhan skyes skye ba'i rgyud smin shog /skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i he ru ka'i/ /phyi dang lus kyi thun bzhir bsgoms byas pas/ /phyi nang dkyil 'khor gsal snang rdzogs pa dang*/ /las rlung ma lus dhū tī 'jug par shog /nang gi rje btsun yab yum zung bsgoms pa'i/

/dpyid dang thig le phan tshun snyoms zhugs las/ /rdzogs rim rtogs pa yongs rdzogs skye ba yi/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par shog /'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa bshad rgyud nyid don/ /grub chen bla ma'i man ngag gnad bsdus pa/ /rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po spyod par bcas/ /rdzogs par bskyed nas dngos grub mchog thob shog /sprul ba'i 'khor lor sbrin sgrar sems brtan pas/ /nyi zla'i 'gros bcom tsaṇ+ḍa li sbar te/ /byang chub sems rgyun dhū tīr 'bab 'dzeg las/ /yas babs mas brtan dga' bzhi skye bar shog /'jug gnas ldang ba'i rlung gi rdor bzlos mchog /dhū tī'i lam nas yang yang goms byas pas/ /haṃ yig zhu ba'i bdud rtsis dbang phyug ma/ /mnyes byas lam gyi 'od gsal 'char bar shog /lte ba'i ye shes sems dpa' snyoms 'jug sgras/ / rjes gzhig rim pas snod bcud kun bsdus pa'i/ /bsam gyis mi khyab 'od gsal phyag rgya cher/ /rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog pa'i nus ldan shog /de las langs tshe gang shar snod bcud kun/ /bde stong chen po'i rol par shar gyur te/ /kun rtog bag chags sbyong la thogs med cing*/ /sems dben mthar thug ting 'dzin rdzogs par shog /de las chu klung dwangs las nya bzhin du/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba sgyu ma'i skur langs nas/ /de nyid 'od gsal 'jug la goms byas pas/ /don gyi lhan skyes mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de nas slob pa'i zung 'jug 'grub pa'i mthar/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin stobs nyid kyis/ /'khrul ba'i bag chags dri ma kun sbyangs te/ /mi slob zung 'jug go 'phang thob par shog /tshe 'dir go 'phang mchog de ma thob par/ /'chi tshe rje btsun 'khor bcas gyis bsus te/ /mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gnas su 'khrid mdzad nas/ /zab lam 'di nyid myur du mthar phyin shog /tshul de sgrub la thogs med mthu ldan pa/ /'dzam gling gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/

/dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma ni 'khor bcas kyis/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs mdzad shog /rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi shis brjod rgyas pa ma lcogs pa'i tshe bsdus pa bya tshul mang yang gcig ni/ rab yangs nam mkhar bde mchog lha tshogs kyis/ /yongs gang me tog char 'beb shis brjod sogs/ /phun tshogs dpal ster mdzad par shes kyis dang*/ /bkra shis gdangs snyan bdag gis bsgrag par bya/ /rdo rje 'chang chen in+d+ra bhū ti dang*/ /sa ra ha dang klu sgrub sha ba ri/ /lū dril rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras sogs/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /khyed kyi mi 'dod rgud pa kun zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /khyab bdag mgon po dpal ldan he ru ka /zag med bde ster rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ /rtsa bshad rgyud dang rim gnyis la sogs pa/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos ma lus la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /khyed kyi mi 'dod rgud pa kun zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /rnam snang la sogs dag byed lha rnams dang*/ /dam tshig sku gsung thugs dang bde chen gyi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs thams cad dang*/ /rdor sems la sogs go cha'i lha rnams la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /khyed kyi mi 'dod rgud pa kun zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /khyab bdag mgon po dpal ldan he ru ka /zag med bde ster rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ /rtsa bshad rgyud dang rim gnyis la sogs pa/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos ma lus la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /khyed kyi mi 'dod rgud pa kun zhi zhing*/

/mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /rnam snang la sogs dag byed lha rnams dang*/ /dam tshig sku gsung thugs dang bde chen gyi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs thams cad dang*/ /rdor sems la sogs go cha'i lha rnams la/ /legs tshogs=/ khyed kyi=/ mthun rkyen=/ phun tshogs=/ rnam dag ye shes rang bzhin las grub cing*/ /rnam mang rin chen rgyan spras rdor 'phreng las/ /rnam par 'phro ba'i me ru dur khrod bcas/ /rnam snang dag ba'i gzhal yas khang che la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis ba'i bkra shis des/ /khyed kyi mi 'dod rgud pa kun zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /yang na/ nam mkha'i khyon ltar zhes sogs bya'o/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi ba'i bla brgyud/ bstod pa smon lam/ shis brjod 'di rnams ni dad stobs phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas brtan blo bzang brtson 'grus zhes bgyi bas rang nyid dad pa kho nas 'di lta bu zhig gyis shig dang*/ kho bos par du bsgrub par bya'o zhes bskul ba la brten nas shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis re gnyis la phan thogs par bsams te sbyar ba'o// //sarba mad+ga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/dpal bde mchog lū hi pa'i bla brgyud bstod pa smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 8-- PAGE 7-- PAGE 1-
